headline: Google says its new Gemini 4 Argon model can now drive Android app development through its Antigravity and command-line tools.
score_reason: Lowered 1 from 5: the announcement is dated 13 Oct 2026 (before 14 Oct) and the claims are Google's own.
importance_line: It affects Android developers who can hand multi-step coding work to an agent, but the quality claims come from Google with no independent test.
summary: Google reports on its Android Developers Blog (13 Oct 2026) that its Gemini 4 Argon model can now be used for Android development through Antigravity, its agent workspace, and the Android command-line tool, with two install commands given. Google says Argon is better at planning and running long, multi-step software tasks and at producing ready-to-use Jetpack Compose user-interface code; these are the company's own claims, and the model is rolling out in supported regions.
